correctness.rationale: The source equilibrium relation reduces exactly to \(F(I)=\beta I+e\sigma u_0I/(1+eu_2I)-C=0\) with \(e=a/b>0\) and \(C=(p_0\sigma+\mu)(R_0-1)>0\). The derivative \(F_I\) is strictly positive, giving a unique positive root. Direct implicit differentiation yields strict signs \(I^*_{u_0}<0\), \(I^*_{u_2}>0\), \(I^*_a<0\), and \(I^*_b>0\). Monotonicity plus the equilibrium identity proves \(I^*\to0\) and \(u_0I^*\to Cb/(a\sigma)\) as \(u_0\to\infty\). The proof does not rely on numerical experiments or stability assumptions.

value.rationale: The distinction between an invasion threshold and endemic burden is mathematically and epidemiologically substantive. The source explicitly uses threshold independence to make a disease-control inference, while its own equilibrium equation yields strict effects of all four information/behavior parameters. The large-\(u_0\) scaling shows the separation sharply: endemic infection can be made arbitrarily small at a fixed supercritical \(R_0\), although it is never eliminated at any finite \(u_0\). This is a motivated correction with direct interpretive value, not a parameter renaming or numerical recomputation.
